data.one_liner: A widget that shows a customizable splash screen with logo, loading indicator and redirects after a duration.
data.what_it_does: Displays a splash screen with optional logo, title, subtitle, background color, gradient or image, and a loading indicator. After a configurable duration it navigates to the next page, optionally with a transition animation.
use_when: You need a quick, customizable splash screen for app launch
You want to show branding or loading progress before the main UI appears
avoid_when: You require a native splash screen that shows before Flutter initializes
You need a full onboarding flow or complex animations beyond simple redirects
strengths: Simple API with many visual customization options
weaknesses: Only covers splash UI, not native launch splash
Adds an extra Flutter widget layer at startup

alternatives.name: flutter_native_splash
alternatives.why_pick_it: Creates a native splash screen that appears before Flutter loads, reducing perceived startup time
